description: Discover the deployed version, request/row limits, tool names, legacy call aliases and check-clean-recheck workflow before integrating. Pass {}: this inventory endpoint accepts no action, policy or filter arguments; use tools/list for callable schemas and trust_check_action for a verdict. The response explains enforcement and limitations, not stored policy or decision history: rules must accompany each check. Free and unauthenticated, with operational usage metadata recorded but no request-body storage. Re-read after a deployment to detect capability changes.
